entities.summary: Andriy Vasilovich Sryubko, is a Ukrainian retired professional ice hockey player. He played for multiple teams during a career that lasted from 1996 until 2013. He also played internationally for the Ukrainian national team at several World Championships, as well as the 2002 Winter Olympics.
